method: One accepted setup request per client outside timing; 20,000 accepted requests at timestamp 1000 cycling across 5,000 clients; fresh limiter per sample; alternating baseline/current order. Baseline extracted from the stated commit. No HTTP/model calls.
limitation: Local microbenchmark of a full live table, not production latency or a judging score. Correctness is checked separately against a 10,000-request reference model.
